title: Suricatoos — Remediation Job
description: A human-approved, signed remediation the cloud dispatches to ONE endpoint agent (ADR-0010). The cloud assigns every identity field; the agent acts only on a job carrying a valid signature (canonical: suricatoos-remediation-v1), bound to its own agent_id + tenant + a single-use nonce + an expiry. Born PENDING_APPROVAL and signed only on approval.

agent_id.description: = cert CN; the single host this job targets

payload.description: opaque to the queue; the executor interprets it (compacted JSON)

nonce.description: per-job entropy folded into the signature; replay defense (agent-side dedup by job_id + expiry via VerifyAt) is enforced by the agent executor

state.description: REJECTED = an operator dropped the job BEFORE delivery (PENDING_APPROVAL/APPROVED); CLOSED = an operator took a job the agent already received (DELIVERED/ACKED/APPLIED/FAILED) out of the queue, keeping its approver and result. The final states are VERIFIED, FAILED, EXPIRED, REJECTED and CLOSED.

approved_by.description: who approved; covered by the signature, and never overwritten by a reject or a close

rejected_by.description: operator who rejected the job (state REJECTED); present only on a rejected job

closed_by.description: operator who took a delivered job out of the queue (state CLOSED); present only on a closed job

closed_reason.description: why the operator closed it; optional

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 over the canonical; present once APPROVED

late_reports.description: Reports the control-plane REFUSED (409) because the job was already final, or APPLIED with a different result — e.g. the agent applied a job after an operator closed it. Kept whole, rollback_token included, so an operator can revert by hand: the last 3, oldest dropped; reported_at is when the server received it. Operator-only data: set only after the job left the agent's hands, so the agent never receives it.

late_reports_total.description: how many reports were ever refused for this job; the newest one kept is number late_reports_total (the control-plane audit line says "late_report #n")
